Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement and Supply of Open Nalah De-silting Machine for Bally Municipality 1. Scope of Supply: The scope shall include the supply, transportation, unloading, installation, co

mmissioning and successful demonstration of a complete, integrated and fully operational Open N alah De-silting Machine as per the prescribed technical specifications and BOQ. The supply shall no t be restricted to the Tractor/Prime Mover alone and shall mandatorily include all specified compo nents, assemblies and attachments, including Hydraulic Arm, Bucket, complete Hydraulic System, Trailer, Hopper, Hydraulic Tipping Mechanism and all associated fittings, controls and accessories r equired for its complete and satisfactory operation. The quoted price shall be inclusive of the entir e machine in complete operational condition. Supply of an incomplete machine shall not be accept ed. 2. Eligibility of Bidder: The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an aut horised dealer/distributor having valid tender-specific authorisation from the OEM. In case of an au thorised dealer, an OEM authorisation certificate confirming supply, warranty and after-sales servi ce support shall be furnished along with the technical bid. 3. Past Experience: The bidder/OEM should have successfully supplied at least one similar or tech nically comparable machine to any Government Department, Urban Local Body, PSU or other instit utional organisation during the preceding five financial years. Documentary evidence in the form of purchase order and satisfactory supply/commissioning certificate shall be furnished. 4. Technical Compliance: The bidder shall submit a duly filled-in point-wise technical compliance statement against every parameter specified in the tender, supported by original OEM brochures, technical catalogues, drawings and other relevant documents. Any deviation, concealment or misr epresentation of technical specifications may render the bid liable to rejection. The machine offere d must conform to applicable Indian Standards/BIS requirements, wherever prescribed. 5. Condition of Machine: The machine offered shall be brand new, unused, of current production and manufactured by the stated OEM. Refurbished, second-hand, reconditioned or obsolete model s shall not be accepted. The OEM's name, make, model and year of manufacture shall be clearly id entifiable. 6. Inspection and Field Demonstration: Bally Municipality shall reserve the right to arrange pre- dispatch inspection, wherever considered necessary. After delivery, the successful bidder shall arr ange a comprehensive operational demonstration and trial run at a site designated by the Municip ality, under actual working conditions, to establish the machine's operational efficiency and confor mity with the prescribed technical specifications. Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory i nspection, testing and commissioning by the competent authority/inspection committee of the Mu nicipality. 7. Delivery and Commissioning: The complete machine shall be delivered within 60 (sixty) day s from the date of issuance of the Purchase Order/Work Order, or such other period as specified in the NIT. The supplier shall complete installation, commissioning and successful trial operation with in 7 (seven) days of delivery. No additional payment shall be admissible towards transportation, lo ading, unloading, installation or commissioning. 8. Warranty: The machine shall carry a comprehensive warranty of at least 12 (twelve) months from the date of successful commissioning or 18 (eighteen) months from the date of de livery, whichever is earlier, covering manufacturing defects, mechanical, hydraulic, electrical a nd other functional failures. All repairs, replacement of defective components, labour and service c harges during the warranty period shall be borne by the supplier without any additional financial li ability to the Municipality. 9. After-Sales Service and Spare Parts: The bidder shall furnish details of the nearest OEM-auth orised service centre/workshop in West Bengal and ensure availability of qualified technical person nel for attending breakdown complaints at the Municipality's premises within 48 hours of notificati on. The OEM shall also ensure the availability of genuine spare parts and technical support for at le ast 5 (five) years from the date of supply. 10. Training and Documentation: The supplier shall provide necessary operational and maintenan ce training, free of cost, to the nominated personnel of Bally Municipality. All relevant technical do cuments, operation manuals, service schedules, warranty certificates, equipment details and spar e-parts catalogue shall be handed over at the time of commissioning. 11. Earnest Money and Performance Security: EMD shall be deposited through the prescribed o nline payment mechanism as stipulated in the NIT, subject to exemptions specifically permitted un der prevailing Government orders. The successful bidder shall furnish Performance Security at the rate and in the manner prescribed under the applicable West Bengal Financial Rules/Finance Depar

tment orders and as specified in the NIT, within the stipulated period after issuance of the Letter of Acceptance. Failure to furnish the same shall render the award liable to cancellation and appropria te action as per rules. 12. Price and Payment: The quoted price shall be firm and inclusive of all applicable taxes, GST, du ties, transportation, transit insurance, loading, unloading, installation, commissioning, demonstrati on and training. No escalation or additional payment shall be entertained. Payment shall be releas ed only after satisfactory delivery, inspection, successful commissioning and acceptance of the ma chine by the competent authority, subject to submission of proper tax invoice and other requisite d ocuments. No advance payment shall be admissible. 13. Liquidated Damages for Delay: In case of delay in delivery or commissioning beyond the stip ulated period, without an approved extension, liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% of the total c ontract value per week or part thereof may be imposed, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total contract value, in accordance with applicable rules and after due notice to the supplier. 14. Defective Supply and Replacement: In the event of any defect, deficiency, non-conformity or unsatisfactory performance detected during inspection, trial operation or warranty period, the sup plier shall rectify the defect or replace the defective component/machine, as applicable, at its own cost within the period stipulated by the Municipality. Failing such compliance, the Municipality shall be entitled to take appropriate remedial action at the risk and cost of the supplier, in accorda nce with the contract. 15. Termination and Penal Action: Submission of false or misleading documents, failure to fulfil c ontractual obligations, unjustified delay, supply of substandard equipment or breach of material co ntractual conditions may result in cancellation of the order, forfeiture of applicable security and oth er appropriate legal/contractual action, including debarment, wherever justified and after following due process. 16. Acceptance of Tender: The Municipality shall not be bound to accept the lowest tender unless the bid is found technically responsive, financially reasonable and otherwise acceptable under the applicable financial rules. The competent authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all bids, in whole or in part, recording reasons as required under the applicable rules. 17. Interpretation and Jurisdiction: In case of any discrepancy concerning technical requirements , the technical specifications and ATC issued by Bally Municipality shall prevail over the bidder's br ochures or commercial descriptions. All matters arising out of the contract shall be subject to the j urisdiction of the competent courts at Howrah, West Bengal. 18. General: All applicable provisions of the West Bengal Financial Rules, relevant Finance Departm ent memoranda, Government procurement instructions and other statutory provisions in force sha ll be strictly complied with. The terms and conditions of the NIT, technical specifications, ATC and a ccepted financial bid shall collectively form part of the contract. In case of any ambiguity, di screpancy, contradiction or overriding of specifications/requirements in the bid documents, the Final Technical Specification uploaded in the ATC documents sha ll prevail and shall be final and binding upon the bidder/successful supplier, subje ct to applicable statutory provisions and mandatory GeM conditions. . 9.
